lines: The App Store takes the changelog of a release from CHANGELOG.md in the tarball, so every release is published without one; make changelog writes its sections into that file once it exists.
The App Store shows no changelog on the page of 0.4.0-dev4.
For a version with a '-' it reads the Unreleased section, which is empty. The section of 0.4.0-dev4 appears with the stable 0.4.0, below that release's own section.
